processing: cropping, padding, alpha-preserving layer separation only; no palette reduction, no low-resolution redraw

layout.walk: one reserved visitor per 16-second cycle after 10 seconds; actor (2+cycle)%N, seat→below row→right aisle→rear meeting lane→target, then reverse

header.overflow: min-width:0; nowrap; hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; full title

nameplates.render: HTML overlay on unchanged wooden modesty panels
nameplates.style: antique brass plate with dark embossed text and provider dot
nameplates.overflow: single line, CSS ellipsis, full name in title

ui.tooltip: state only; names visible on desk plates

drawingOrder: depth-sort pods and walkers by feet Y

stateContract.needsAttention: independent boolean; draw attention effect above current state
stateContract.walking: auxiliary locomotion, use walk_left/walk_right while traveling
stateContract.away: rest-area seated pose; place on the existing sofa; same feet anchor
stateContract.assetGeometry: assets.size and layout remain v10 native logical coordinates; runtimeSize is actual WebP size; sheets dimensions are actual source pixels
